display.name: Apple Development Workflow
display.description: Experimental Swift SDK, native Apple measurements, whole-host context, captures, and Xcode builds. Span-backed measurements remain separate by source and scope.

display.name: Session
display.description: Leave empty to show all records. Paste an exact session ID to filter.

display.name: Build
display.description: Leave empty to show all records. Paste an exact build ID to filter.

display.name: SDK callback rate
display.description: Renderer callback cadence. This does not measure display presentation. Values average complete SDK windows within each chart bucket.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, CAST(attributes->>'recorded_at' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS time, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, avg(CAST(attributes->>'render_callback_fps' AS DOUBLE)) AS callback_hz FROM records WHERE kind = 'span' AND ($session = '' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.performance.window' GROUP BY time, session ORDER BY time LIMIT 10000

display.name: SDK worst window p95
display.description: Each point is the maximum five-second-window p95 in the chart bucket. It is not a session p95. Preparation includes CPU-side waits. GPU command duration is not GPU utilization.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, CAST(attributes->>'recorded_at' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS time, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, max(CAST(attributes->>'frame_interval_p95_ms' AS DOUBLE)) AS callback_interval_p95_ms, max(CAST(attributes->>'frame_encode_wall_p95_ms' AS DOUBLE)) AS preparation_p95_ms, max(CAST(attributes->>'gpu_command_p95_ms' AS DOUBLE)) AS gpu_command_p95_ms FROM records WHERE kind = 'span' AND ($session = '' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.performance.window' GROUP BY time, session ORDER BY time LIMIT 10000

display.name: SDK sessions and cohorts
display.description: Select a session and copy its build ID into the Build filter to inspect the observed build. Match device, configuration, mode, size, seed, and workload before comparing performance.

spec.query: SELECT attributes->>'session_id' AS session, attributes->>'build.id' AS build, service_name AS exporter_service, attributes->>'build.configuration' AS configuration, attributes->>'render_mode' AS mode, attributes->>'workload' AS workload, attributes->>'aurora_layers' AS detail, attributes->>'drawable_width' AS width, attributes->>'drawable_height' AS height, attributes->>'game.seed' AS seed, attributes->>'thermal_state' AS thermal, count(*) AS windows, min(start_timestamp) AS first_window, max(start_timestamp) AS last_window FROM records WHERE kind = 'span' AND ($session = '' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.performance.window' GROUP BY session, build, exporter_service, configuration, mode, workload, detail, width, height, seed, thermal ORDER BY last_window DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Apple presented FPS during attach
display.description: Apple presentation measurements from live attach. Each series identifies a session and layer. Captures and state aggregates appear in separate tables. Weight each interval by its duration.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, CAST(attributes->>'measurement.ended_at' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS time, concat(attributes->>'session_id', '/layer-', attributes->>'layer_index') AS session_layer, sum(CAST(attributes->>'presented_frames' AS DOUBLE)) / nullif(sum(CAST(attributes->>'window_seconds' AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS presented_fps FROM records WHERE kind = 'span' AND ($session = '' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.native.performance' AND attributes->>'measurement.scope' = 'layer' GROUP BY time, session_layer ORDER BY time LIMIT 10000

display.name: Apple mean presentation timings
display.description: Each point averages Apple interval means from live attach at measurement time. It is not a per-frame session mean or a percentile.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, CAST(attributes->>'measurement.ended_at' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS time, concat(attributes->>'session_id', '/layer-', attributes->>'layer_index') AS session_layer, avg(CAST(attributes->>'gpu_wall_mean_ms' AS DOUBLE)) AS gpu_mean_ms, avg(CAST(attributes->>'drawable_wait_mean_ms' AS DOUBLE)) AS drawable_wait_mean_ms FROM records WHERE kind = 'span' AND ($session = '' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.native.performance' AND attributes->>'measurement.scope' = 'layer' GROUP BY time, session_layer ORDER BY time LIMIT 10000

display.name: Apple process memory during attach
display.description: Physical footprint and Metal allocation for the game process. These are separate measurements and must not be added. The x-axis uses export time because process summaries lack a native interval timestamp.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, start_timestamp) AS time, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, avg(CAST(attributes->>'process.memory_mib' AS DOUBLE)) AS footprint_mib, avg(CAST(attributes->>'process.metal_allocated_mib' AS DOUBLE)) AS metal_allocated_mib FROM records WHERE kind = 'span' AND ($session = '' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.native.performance' AND attributes->>'measurement.scope' = 'process' GROUP BY time, session ORDER BY time LIMIT 10000

display.name: Whole-host CPU during game observation
display.description: Average CPU load across the Mac, including unrelated apps and builds. It is not game CPU usage. Samples arrive only while attach or test-game runs. Sessions remain separate.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, CAST(attributes->>'recorded_at' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS time, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, 100 * avg(CAST(attributes->>'cpu_utilization' AS DOUBLE)) AS host_cpu_percent FROM records WHERE kind = 'span' AND ($session = '' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.host.sample' AND attributes->>'measurement.scope' = 'whole_host' GROUP BY time, session ORDER BY time LIMIT 10000

display.name: Whole-host memory categories
display.description: Free, wired, and compressed memory are selected OS categories. They do not form a complete memory accounting or a game-memory estimate.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, CAST(attributes->>'recorded_at' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS time, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, avg(CAST(attributes->>'memory_free_bytes' AS DOUBLE)) / 1073741824 AS free_gib, avg(CAST(attributes->>'memory_wired_bytes' AS DOUBLE)) / 1073741824 AS wired_gib, avg(CAST(attributes->>'memory_compressed_bytes' AS DOUBLE)) / 1073741824 AS compressed_gib FROM records WHERE kind = 'span' AND ($session = '' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.host.sample' AND attributes->>'measurement.scope' = 'whole_host' GROUP BY time, session ORDER BY time LIMIT 10000

display.name: Native capture summaries by scope
display.description: Captures can overlap. Process, layer, and state-layer rows remain separate. Do not sum captures or combine layer and state-layer totals. Full recordings and symbols remain on the recording Mac.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp AS exported, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, attributes->>'build.id' AS build, attributes->>'capture.id' AS capture, attributes->>'measurement.scope' AS scope, attributes->>'state.label' AS state, attributes->>'layer_index' AS layer, CAST(attributes->>'presented_fps' AS DOUBLE) AS presented_fps, attributes->>'measurement.started_at' AS measured_start, attributes->>'measurement.ended_at' AS measured_end, attributes->>'measurement.requested_start' AS requested_start, attributes->>'measurement.requested_end' AS requested_end, attributes->>'capture.path' AS local_artifact FROM records WHERE kind = 'span' AND ($session = '' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.native.capture_summary' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Observed Xcode builds
display.description: The Build filter connects runtime records to builds. The Session filter does not apply here because the build command and app have different sessions. Only companion builds provide complete timing.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp, attributes->>'build.id' AS build, attributes->>'build.configuration' AS configuration, attributes->>'build.scenario' AS scenario, CAST(attributes->>'build.duration_seconds' AS DOUBLE) AS seconds, CAST(attributes->>'build.exit_code' AS DOUBLE) AS exit_code, CAST(attributes->>'build.warnings' AS DOUBLE) AS warnings, CAST(attributes->>'build.errors' AS DOUBLE) AS errors, trace_id FROM records WHERE kind = 'span' AND span_name = 'xcode.build' AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Instruments CPU profiles
display.description: Optional live recordings. CPU weights are sampled running work, not wall time or frame latency. Main-thread identification uses Apple's label. Profiling adds overhead. Full recordings remain on the recording Mac.

spec.query: SELECT attributes->>'profile.started_at' AS measured_start, attributes->>'profile.ended_at' AS measured_end, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, attributes->>'build.id' AS build, attributes->>'capture.id' AS capture, CAST(attributes->>'profile.duration_seconds' AS DOUBLE) AS seconds, attributes->>'cpu.summary_available' AS summary_available, CAST(attributes->>'cpu.samples' AS DOUBLE) AS samples, CAST(attributes->>'cpu.sampled_weight_ms' AS DOUBLE) AS sampled_cpu_ms, CAST(attributes->>'cpu.main_thread_sampled_weight_ms' AS DOUBLE) AS main_thread_sampled_ms, CAST(attributes->>'cpu.unresolved_samples' AS DOUBLE) AS unresolved_samples, attributes->>'profile.observation_gap' AS observation_gap, attributes->>'capture.path' AS local_artifact FROM records WHERE kind = 'span' AND ($session = '' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.cpu.profile' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Top CPU leaf functions by capture
display.description: Up to 20 self-weight functions per capture. This is not an inclusive call tree. Fractions use all selected running samples, including unresolved samples. Tables can truncate at 100 rows. Filter the session/build and time range. Do not sum overlapping captures.

spec.query: SELECT attributes->>'profile.ended_at' AS measured_end, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, attributes->>'capture.id' AS capture, CAST(attributes->>'function.rank' AS DOUBLE) AS rank, attributes->>'function.name' AS function, attributes->>'function.image' AS image, CAST(attributes->>'function.samples' AS DOUBLE) AS samples, CAST(attributes->>'function.sampled_weight_ms' AS DOUBLE) AS sampled_cpu_ms, CAST(attributes->>'function.sampled_weight_fraction' AS DOUBLE) AS fraction FROM records WHERE kind = 'span' AND ($session = '' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.cpu.function' ORDER BY measured_end DESC, capture, rank ASC LIMIT 100

display.name: GPU replay encoder and shader costs
display.description: One captured workload replay. Up to three cost-ranked encoders and three cost-ranked shaders from Apple tables. Costs within different scopes overlap. Do not sum them or interpret them as live frame latency, utilization, or CPU waiting. Raw captures and resource contents remain local.

spec.query: SELECT attributes->>'capture.ended_at' AS captured_end, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, attributes->>'capture.id' AS capture, attributes->>'measurement.scope' AS scope, attributes->>'gpu.node.label' AS node, attributes->>'gpu.shader.stage' AS stage, CAST(attributes->>'gpu.replay.duration_ms' AS DOUBLE) AS encoder_ms, CAST(attributes->>'gpu.replay.cost_fraction' AS DOUBLE) AS cost_fraction, CAST(attributes->>'gpu.shader.spilled_bytes' AS DOUBLE) AS spilled_bytes, CAST(attributes->>'gpu.shader.wait_instructions' AS DOUBLE) AS wait_instructions FROM records WHERE kind = 'span' AND ($session = '' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.gpu.replay' ORDER BY captured_end DESC, capture, scope, cost_fraction DESC LIMIT 100
